perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.desc: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.desc: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Iron Grip
perks.desc: Massively improves weapon stability at the cost of reload speed.

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.desc:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.desc: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Iron Reach
perks.desc: Massively improves weapon range at the cost of weapon stability.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Skulking Wolf
perks.desc: While at low health, final blows with this weapon grant enhanced radar, remove you from opposing Guardians' radar, and make combatants less aggressive toward you.

perks.name: Veist Stinger
perks.desc: Damaging an enemy with this weapon has a small chance to reload the magazine and increase movement speed while aiming down sights. Bows receive faster draw speed and swords receive faster charge rate while this perk is active.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Reload. Rapid-Fire(720) Arc Auto Rifle Primary Ammo. "While I like Dark Decider coming back and more Veist-Rapid Fire Frame autos is never a bad thing. They are incredibly fun to use. It harps back to Vanilla when I used Hollow Earth nearly every day. A better version in this economy? Heck yeah. Golden Tricorn with an Arc subclass will give you damage that scales up to almost GM level activities. Dragonfly gives you some great add clear potential with Veist Stinger to keep up the shooting, pair that with Subsistence and you can almost non-stop firing. Titans Rejoice a legendary Sweet Business that has ‘splosions!"

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Stability. Rapid-Fire(720) Arc Auto Rifle Primary Ammo. "In PvP 720s aren’t super meta, but they are consistent, fun and surprisingly lethal. Dynamic Sway Reduction and Rangefinder will give you great stability and range, you can bump up recoil direction to 88 with Arrowhead Brake and a counterbalance mod. Ricochet Rounds gives you some great stability before Dynamic Sway Reduction kicks in."

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): Recommended MW: Range. Rapid-Fire(720) Arc Auto Rifle Primary Ammo. "In PvP 720s aren’t super meta, but they are consistent, fun and surprisingly lethal. Dynamic Sway Reduction and Rangefinder will give you great stability and range, you can bump up recoil direction to 88 with Arrowhead Brake and a counterbalance mod. Ricochet Rounds gives you some great stability before Dynamic Sway Reduction kicks in."

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "I do not know what it is about the Veist style rapid fire frames, but I vastly prefer them over non-Veist ones. Dark Decider is almost a carbon copy of my favorite rapid fire frame of all time Hollow Earth from Year 1. Subsistence and voltshot are going to be the roll to get on Dark Decider for PvE. Golden tricorn is fantastic but requires a bit more thinking to maintain 2x." Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "For PvP Dark Decider fits into a weird spot. It has some of the lowest base stats within its archetypes but some of the most unique perks that can put it well above the rest. For one, it is the only rapid-fire frame to roll rangefinder. Putting it in a range class well above its stats. It can also roll Iron Grip for a whopping +20 stability without sacrificing your barrel and magazine perks to stability. The only other auto rifle in this class to compete with Dark Decider would be Krait and given comparable rolls (DD - hammer-forged, accurized, iron grip, rangefinder / K - hammer-forged, ricochet, overflow, moving target) Dark Decider would have 2 whole meters over Krait. Which is a lot within the auto rifle space." Recommended MW - Range.
